rules.name: the floor has had its minutes

steps.text: Rook: I'm first! I'm first! ...The road tipped. You're first.
Rook: You're hurt. I'll say where it tips. Don't make it a thing.
Rook: Spend those. First place is heavy to carry.
Rook: Second. ...Second. It's a number, at least.
